event_detail: Drawer: the gripper hangs at the left corner beside the closed drawers below the counter for 4.8 s, moving slightly back and forth, without grasping a handle or opening a drawer.
evidence: In the shoulder views the drawer fronts under the counter look closed (flush, handles in place) in all four frames, and the arm stays in nearly the same pose at the left edge of the counter. The wrist camera only sees a gray cabinet panel and the wooden floor, with no open drawer interior and no straw. Nothing is in the gripper. I cannot fully rule out that a drawer outside the views is open, so confidence is moderate.
